tenures.role: An MWE original of the fed's own 2007 first season — the man Sonny Williams faced on MWE's first show — written out of the ring early with a staged career-ending injury and staged once more a year later, out of the ring, in another wrestler's roleplay
tenures.source: MWE's own served documents. The first show: promotions/mwe/archive/tribulation-2009-05-24.html, where MWE's own owner inducts Sonny Williams into the fed's Hall of Fame as "the ONLY superstar in MWE history to go from facing John Austin to David Whitman", over "the memories from MWE's first show". The 2007 window and standing: promotions/mwe/rp/faking-it.html, 14 August 2008 — "I still remember the days of John Austin" and "John Austin was a good man...who made Sonny Williams look like hot shit", against that same document's own "Approximately one year ago...Sonny Williams was kicking the show off"; promotions/mwe/rp/setting-the-tone.html, 6 August 2008 — "you'd be NOTHING without John Austin. Yeah I said it, John Austin is better than Sonny Williams EVER will be"; promotions/mwe/rp/different-time-same-result.html, 10 January 2009 — "bring back John Austin or whatever other old MWE orignal"; promotions/mwe/rp/theres-15-and-a-pack-of-marbs-sitting-next-to-me-while-i.html, 20 November 2009, which invokes the name the same way. The staged appearance: promotions/mwe/rp/memoirs-of-a-superstar.html, 28 September 2008, where the character speaks his own lines and accounts for his own exit — "A few weeks after i started MWE I had a career ending injury".

identity.note: GAVEL, 2026-09-02 ("Agreed on the Austin memorial connection"): MWE's 2007 John Austin and this row are ONE character, and the name recurrence the whq wing had recorded without resolving (data/promotions.json, whq's own fourth provenance note) is ruled a join rather than a coincidence. The receipt is one author's own two-part roleplay of 14 March 2009, which says it from both sides: in character, promotions/mwe/rp/a-semi-rolls-through.html — "In WHQ, I worked with a man named John Austin"; out of character, promotions/mwe/rp/still-just-rolling-through.html — "fedded as Semi with Tim (as John Austin) in WHQ." Same full name on both sides, the same family of federations (WcE, WWA, eWa, SWA, WHQ, MWE), adjoining eras, and the same voice attesting both. No MWE-side character row exists or is owed: MWE never carried one, so the mwe tenure reaches MWE from this row rather than a second row being minted and merged. Distinct from MWE's own separately carded jeff-austin-mwe — re-checked, different given name, different staging.
